name: @papercusp/backup
description: Per-workspace kopia backup system: snapshot/restore/verify/maintenance over the kopia CLI, SQL-backed snapshot+settings+destination metadata, pre-snapshot DB-dump hook, interval+event scheduling, and orphan sweep. Host-agnostic — the org PG handle, workspaces-root path, schema bootstrap, and embedded-pg admin URL are injected via configureBackup(). Zero @papercusp/@restart runtime deps.
